record.summary: The docker-compose lab: RabbitMQ 4 (management + stream plugins, localhost port bindings, stream advertised host) and TimescaleDB (PostgreSQL 17) with the schema migrations that define the frames hypertable, its identity index, the frames_1s continuous aggregate, compression policy, and the events / service_metrics tables. Plus the run scripts that supervise the services during drills.
record.title: Infrastructure: broker, database, provisioning
